description: Reviewed same-number protobuf fields whose type or cardinality differs between the exact-SA targets. eng/Test-CrossTargetProtocol.ps1 fails on any such wire hazard not listed here with the exact signatures of both targets.

typeConflicts.rationale: Exact-target MP bindings differ: SA 2026 takes one object-type choice and a point offset, while SA 2024 takes seven per-shape Booleans. Each target's request mirrors its own release; a client sending one target's request to the other server is misinterpreted on the wire.
Same exact-target binding difference as field 1: SA 2026 point_offset (double) shares number 2 with SA 2024 construct_cylinders (bool), so the wire types are incompatible across targets.
